snapshots.title: Care of dying adults in the last days of life — Recommendations
snapshots.organization: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE)
limitations: Professional guideline; cannot be reduced into family-facing instructions without clinical review.
Local care-team assessment remains necessary for any particular person.

snapshots.title: What to do after someone dies
limitations: Jurisdiction and setting vary; do not render as universal legal instruction.
Use as orientation source only until local-law review.

snapshots.title: Information about how a death is verified and certified
limitations: Specific to named public guidance context; avoid universalizing beyond jurisdiction.
Do not turn into instructions for untrained readers to verify death.

snapshots.title: Preparing for a death at home — what to do when someone dies at home
limitations: Country-specific public health information; route all legal details to local authority/care-team review.
Useful to preserve the idea that expected home death may not require panic, but not enough for local instructions.
